```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(Seurat)
packageVersion("Seurat")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(Matrix)
```

# Load and prepare datasets

```{r}
ile_5p <- readRDS("PREDICT/ligand_receptor/seu5p_ile_lp_filt.rds")
ile_3p <- readRDS("PREDICT/ligand_receptor/paper_final.rds")
thomas_ile <- readRDS("PREDICT/ligand_receptor/thomas_merged_Ileum.rds")


ile_5p$source <- "PREDICT 5p"
ile_3p$source <- "PREDICT 3p"
thomas_ile$source <- "Thomas"


gut_all_cells  <- merge(ile_5p, c(ile_3p, thomas_ile))

rm(ile_5p)
rm(ile_3p)
rm(thomas_ile)

gut_all_cells  <- JoinLayers(gut_all_cells)
gut_all_cells  <- SplitObject(gut_all_cells, split.by = "source")

# normalize and identify variable features for each dataset independently
gut_all_cells <- lapply(X = gut_all_cells, FUN = function(x) {
    DefaultAssay(x)  <- "RNA"
    x$barcode  <- colnames(x)
    x <- NormalizeData(x)
    x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 1200)
})

library(STACAS)
gut_all_cells <- Run.STACAS(gut_all_cells, dims = 1:20)
gut_all_cells <- RunUMAP(gut_all_cells, dims = 1:20) 
DimPlot(gut_all_cells)
saveRDS(gut_all_cells, "PREDICT/ligand_receptor/gut_all_cells_thomas_3p_5p_integrated.rds")



```

# Reclustering major cell types

```{r}
celltypes <- levels(factor(gut_all_cells$annotations_coarse))
celltypes



for(i in 1:10){
  gut_sub <- subset(gut_all_cells, annotations_coarse == celltypes[i])
  gut_sub  <- SplitObject(gut_sub, split.by = "source")

# normalize and identify variable features for each dataset independently
gut_sub <- lapply(X = gut_sub, FUN = function(x) {
    DefaultAssay(x)  <- "RNA"
    x$barcode  <- colnames(x)
    x <- NormalizeData(x)
    x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 1200)
})

gut_sub <- Run.STACAS(gut_sub, dims = 1:20)
gut_sub <- RunUMAP(gut_sub, dims = 1:20) 
DimPlot(gut_sub)
gut_sub <- FindNeighbors(gut_sub)
gut_sub <- FindClusters(gut_sub, res = c(0.2,0.5,0.8))

saveRDS(gut_sub, paste0("PREDICT/ligand_receptor/gut_sub_",i,".rds"))
  
}
```

```{r}
reduced_annot  <- function(seurat_object, tier_name, n_cells_to_other){
    md  <- seurat_object@meta.data
    tier_name_red  <- paste0(tier_name,"_red")
    cell_types_keep  <- (md  %>% group_by_at(tier_name)  %>% tally()  %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% dplyr::filter(n > n_cells_to_other))[[tier_name]]
    md[[tier_name_red]]  <- if_else(md[[tier_name]] %in% cell_types_keep,as.character(md[[tier_name]]),"Other")
    seurat_object  <- AddMetaData(seurat_object, metadata = md[[tier_name_red]], tier_name_red)
    return(seurat_object)
}


gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "cell_type_lvl2", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "minor", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "curatedname", n_cells_to_other = 100)



DimPlot(gut_sub, group.by = "cell_type_lvl2_red", label = T)
DimPlot(gut_sub, group.by = "minor_red", label = T)
DimPlot(gut_sub, group.by = "curatedname_red", label = T)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
reduced_annot  <- function(seurat_object, tier_name, n_cells_to_other){
    md  <- seurat_object@meta.data
    tier_name_red  <- paste0(tier_name,"_red")
    cell_types_keep  <- (md  %>% group_by_at(tier_name)  %>% tally()  %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% dplyr::filter(n > n_cells_to_other))[[tier_name]]
    md[[tier_name_red]]  <- if_else(md[[tier_name]] %in% cell_types_keep,as.character(md[[tier_name]]),"Other")
    seurat_object  <- AddMetaData(seurat_object, metadata = md[[tier_name_red]], tier_name_red)
    return(seurat_object)
}


gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "cell_type_lvl2", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "minor", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "curatedname", n_cells_to_other = 100)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
reduced_annot  <- function(seurat_object, tier_name, n_cells_to_other){
    md  <- seurat_object@meta.data
    tier_name_red  <- paste0(tier_name,"_red")
    cell_types_keep  <- (md  %>% group_by_at(tier_name)  %>% tally()  %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% dplyr::filter(n > n_cells_to_other))[[tier_name]]
    md[[tier_name_red]]  <- if_else(md[[tier_name]] %in% cell_types_keep,as.character(md[[tier_name]]),"Other")
    seurat_object  <- AddMetaData(seurat_object, metadata = md[[tier_name_red]], tier_name_red)
    return(seurat_object)
}
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
reduced_annot  <- function(seurat_object, tier_name, n_cells_to_other){
    md  <- seurat_object@meta.data
    tier_name_red  <- paste0(tier_name,"_red")
    cell_types_keep  <- (md  %>% group_by_at(tier_name)  %>% tally()  %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% dplyr::filter(n > n_cells_to_other))[[tier_name]]
    md[[tier_name_red]]  <- if_else(md[[tier_name]] %in% cell_types_keep,as.character(md[[tier_name]]),"Other")
    seurat_object  <- AddMetaData(seurat_object, metadata = md[[tier_name_red]], tier_name_red)
    return(seurat_object)
}


gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "cell_type_lvl2", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "minor", n_cells_to_other = 100)
gut_sub <- reduced_annot(gut_sub, "curatedname", n_cells_to_other = 100)
```

# Aggregate Expression

```{r}

gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data <- gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(patient2 = ifelse(!is.na(patient),patient,
                           ifelse(!is.na(Patient),Patient,participant_id)))


gut_all_cells_filt$patient2 %>% table

is.na(gut_all_cells_filt$patient2) %>% table

gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine_patient2 <- paste(gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine, gut_all_cells_filt$patient2, sep = "---")


aggexp <- AggregateExpression(gut_all_cells_filt, assay = "RNA", group.by = "annotations_fine_patient2", return.seurat = T, 
                              features = c('IFNG',
'IL27',
'IFNB1',
'IL21',
'IL10',
'IFNA16',
'TNF',
'IFNA5',
'IFNA2',
'OSM',
'IL4',
'IFNA13',
'IFNA14',
'IFNK',
'IFNA8',
'IFNA4',
'IL6',
'SIGLEC14',
'VSIG10'
))

aggexp@meta.data <- aggexp@meta.data %>% separate(annotations_fine_patient2, into = c("annotations_fine", "patient2"), 
                                                  sep = "---", remove = F)

annotations <- gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data %>% group_by(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine) %>% tally() %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-n) %>% unique %>% 
  mutate(annotations_coarse = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Transitional Enterocytes", "Enterocytes", annotations_coarse)) %>% unique

annotations %>% arrange(annotations_fine) 

md <- aggexp@meta.data 

md <- left_join(md, annotations)

rownames(md) <- colnames(aggexp)

aggexp@meta.data <- md



```

# Markers in main annotations

```{r}
gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_main_patients <- paste(gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_main, gut_all_cells_filt$patient2, sep = "__")

aggexp <- AggregateExpression(gut_all_cells_filt, assay = "RNA", group.by = c("annotations_main_patients"), return.seurat = T)


aggexp@meta.data <- aggexp@meta.data %>% separate(annotations_main_patients, into = c("annotations_main", "patient"), sep = "--", remove = F)

Idents(aggexp) <- aggexp$annotations_main

aggexp$annotations_main %>% table


mrk_aggexp_annotations_main <- FindAllMarkers(aggexp)


mrk_aggexp_annotations_main %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(gene, pattern = "\\.")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(gene, pattern = "^LINC")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cluster == "T cells") %>% pull(gene)
```

# Markers in annotations fine

```{r}
annotations <- gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data %>% group_by(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine) %>% tally() %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-n) %>% unique %>% 
  mutate(annotations_coarse = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Transitional Enterocytes", "Enterocytes", annotations_coarse)) %>% unique

gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data %>% group_by(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine, source) %>% tally() %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  arrange(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine)
```

```{r}
gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine_patients <- paste(gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine, gut_all_cells_filt$patient2, sep = "__")

aggexp <- AggregateExpression(gut_all_cells_filt, assay = "RNA", group.by = c("annotations_fine_patients"), return.seurat = T)


annotations

new_md <- aggexp@meta.data %>% 
  separate(annotations_fine_patients, into = c("annotations_fine", "patient"), sep = "--", remove = F) %>% 
  left_join(annotations)


rownames(new_md) <- colnames(aggexp)

aggexp@meta.data <- new_md

for(i in levels(factor(aggexp$annotations_main))){
  if(i != "Mast cells"){
    seu_sub <- subset(aggexp, annotations_main == i)
    
    Idents(seu_sub) <- seu_sub$annotations_fine
    mrk <- FindAllMarkers(seu_sub, only.pos = T)
    
    if(!is.null(mrk)){
      if(i == levels(factor(aggexp$annotations_main))[1]){
        mrk$annotations_main <- i
        df_all <- mrk
        
      } else {
        mrk$annotations_main <- i
        df_all <- rbind(df_all, mrk)
      }
    }
  }
}

annotations %>% dplyr::filter(annotations_main == "Mast cells")
```

```{r}
df_all$annotations_main %>% table
```

```{r}
df_all %>% dplyr::filter(annotations_main == "T cells") %>%

  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
  summarise(genes = list(gene)) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
```

# Updated annotations

```{r}
new_md <-  gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(annotations_coarse = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Transitional Enterocytes", "Enterocytes", annotations_coarse)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Transitional Enterocytes", "Absorptive enterocytes", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Homeostatic Enterocytes", "Absorptive enterocytes", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Inflammatory Fibroblasts LP", "Inflammatory fibroblasts", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Homeostatic monocytes", "Inflammatory Mo-derived MQ", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Activated chemokine-producing monocytes", "Activated monocytes", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "CD8 Tmk", "CD8 Tex", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "CD8 Tcm", "Tmem", annotations_fine)) %>% 
  mutate(annotations_fine = ifelse(annotations_fine == "Inflammatory Fibroblasts LP", "Inflammatory fibroblasts", annotations_fine)) 
  

new_md %>% group_by(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine, source) %>% tally() %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  arrange(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine)

table_annotations <- new_md %>% group_by(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine, source) %>% tally() %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  arrange(annotations_main, annotations_coarse, annotations_fine)


write.csv(table_annotations, "fig4_supp_table_annots.csv")
```

```{r}
write.csv(new_md, "ligand_receptor/table_updated_annotations_metadata.csv")
```

```{r}

is.na(new_md$sample_id) %>% table

 corr_thomas$sample_id %>% table

  group_by(annotations_fine, sample_id) %>% 
  tally()

thomas_cd4_ctl <- corr_thomas %>% 
  dplyr::filter(annotations_fine == "CD4 CTL") %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, n_cd4_ctl = n)

thomas_cd4_ctl


stat_thomas <- corr_thomas %>% 
  dplyr::filter(annotations_fine != "CD4 CTL") %>% 
  left_join(thomas_cd4_ctl)


stat_thomas <- stat_thomas %>% 
  group_by(annotations_fine) %>% 
  rstatix::cor_test(n, n_cd4_ctl)

stat_thomas %>% arrange(p)

stat_thomas$source <- "Thomas"
```

## All correlations together

```{r}
stst_all <- rbind(stat_3p, stat_5p, stat_thomas)

stst_all %>% arrange(p)

annots <- new_md %>% dplyr::select(annotations_fine, annotations_main) %>% unique

annots

stst_all %>% 
  mutate(signif = ifelse(p*62<0.05,"Yes","No")) %>% 
  left_join(annots) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cor, y = reorder(annotations_fine, X = cor, FUN = mean, decreasing = F))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(color = annotations_main, fill = annotations_main), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = annotations_main, shape = signif, size = -log(p, base = 10))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15,16)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.5,3)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial")) +
  ylab("")

library(svglite)
ggsave("ligand_receptor/boxplot_correlation.svg", width = 14, height = 30, units = "cm")
ggsave("ligand_receptor/boxplot_correlation.png", width = 14, height = 30, units = "cm")
```

## IL27 expression

```{r}
gut_all_cells_filt@meta.data <- new_md

gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine_patient2 <- paste(gut_all_cells_filt$annotations_fine, gut_all_cells_filt$patient2, sep = "---")


aggexp <- AggregateExpression(gut_all_cells_filt, assay = "RNA", group.by = "annotations_fine_patient2", return.seurat = T, 
                              features = c('IFNG',
'IL27',
'IFNB1',
'IL21',
'IL10',
'IFNA16',
'TNF',
'IFNA5',
'IFNA2',
'OSM',
'IL4',
'IFNA13',
'IFNA14',
'IFNK',
'IFNA8',
'IFNA4',
'IL6',
'SIGLEC14',
'VSIG10'
))

aggexp@meta.data <- aggexp@meta.data %>% separate(annotations_fine_patient2, into = c("annotations_fine", "patient2"), 
                                                  sep = "---", remove = F)


patient_source <- new_md %>% dplyr::select(patient2, source) %>% unique

md_to_use <- aggexp@meta.data %>% left_join(patient_source)

md_to_use$IL27 <- aggexp@assays$RNA$counts[which(rownames(aggexp@assays$RNA$counts)=="IL27"),]

annots

md_to_use %>% 
  left_join(annots) %>% 
  group_by(annotations_fine, source, annotations_main) %>% 
  summarise(mean_IL27 = mean(as.numeric(IL27))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(annotations_fine, X = mean_IL27, FUN = mean), y = mean_IL27)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 0, aes(color = annotations_main, fill = annotations_main), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = source)) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial")) +
  ylab("")
```

# Save as h5ad

```{r}
library(SeuratDisk)
gut_all_cells_filt_save <- gut_all_cells_filt

DefaultAssay(gut_all_cells_filt_save) <- "RNA"
gut_all_cells_filt_save@assays$integrated <- NULL
gut_all_cells_filt_save@assays$prediction.score.id <- NULL
gut_all_cells_filt_save <- JoinLayers(gut_all_cells_filt_save)


```

```{r}
# Remove reductions you don't need
gut_all_cells_filt_save@reductions <- list()

# Remove neighbor graphs
gut_all_cells_filt_save@graphs <- list()
gut_all_cells_filt_save@neighbors <- list()

# Remove misc data if not needed
gut_all_cells_filt_save@misc <- list()


gut_all_cells_filt_save[["RNA"]]["scale.data"] <- NULL

 gut_export <- gut_all_cells_filt_save
gut_export[["RNA"]] <- as(
  object = gut_all_cells_filt_save[["RNA"]],
  Class = "Assay"
)

SaveH5Seurat(
  gut_export,
  filename = "gut_export.h5Seurat",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Convert(
  "gut_export.h5Seurat",
  dest = "h5ad",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

 


```
